chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: One frame. The system wakes the robot, points its bags at a chunk of entities, then walks the brick door by door.

chapters.title: Wake
chapters.text: Get Execution builds this frame's remote control. Update Generated refreshes component handles. Time and logger hop into Grove Context.

chapters.title: Walk
chapters.text: Set Chunk binds containers. Execute starts at Root. The Type number opens a door that calls a static method.

chapters.title: Act
chapters.text: Leaf methods write transforms. Data boxes only open when something asks Calculate. Inputs were dropped into the backpack first.
